Vestige (अवशेष) - A trace, mark, or visible sign left by something that no longer exists; a remaining bit or indication of something lost or vanished.

Rogue (धूर्त ) - A dishonest or unprincipled person; a scoundrel or rascal; someone who behaves in an abnormal or unpredictable way.

Pretentious (दिखावटी)- Attempting to impress by affecting greater importance, talent, culture, etc., than is actually possessed; making an extravagant outward show, often to mask inner insecurity.

Ingenuous (सरल) - Innocent and unsuspecting; lacking in cunning or deceit; straightforward and candid in manner or behavior.
